scope: Native/H5 purchases, permission-page return, microphone lifecycle, and APNs registration boundary

conventions.authorization: User explicitly authorized changing both conventions for the StoreKit handshake and recovery model.
rules: Use existing Pinia actions, branded Loading and ConfirmDialog components.
Only StoreKit-verified, account/product/request-bound transactions may credit the H5 ledger.
Persist the H5 ledger and purchase result atomically before acknowledging and finishing the native transaction.
Interrupted payment recovery does not repurchase automatically; leaving a page is not Apple payment cancellation.
Unavailable products, missing signing and absent push delivery services must not be represented as working production services.

purchases: Eight supplied Product IDs replace the six purchasable prototype packages; historical packages and ledgers remain readable.
Runtime availability, price and currency come from StoreKit, not the supplied reference USD amounts.
Versioned whitelist bridge supports catalogue, start, status, verification, pending recovery, acknowledgement and explicit interrupted-request release.
Native request/token reservation is durable before the accepted response; a repeated request cannot start another purchase.
Transaction.updates and unfinished transactions recover across startup, foreground and account changes.
Transaction ID replay is idempotent; late verified success can reconcile the original request, never another account.
Native delivery journals are not signature proof; revoked or unverified transactions do not deliver coins.
The old one-way purchase protocol remains fail-closed because its eight-second payment deadline is incompatible with real StoreKit.
permissions_and_media: Permission-page requesting lock is released before taking the navigation lock; grants return once and navigation failure leaves Back usable.
Hide, unmount and account-change generations suppress stale permission completions.
WKWebView media capture validates the trusted main frame and calls real Apple device authorization APIs; existing denial is not overridden.
Recorder startup invokes getUserMedia in the initiating call stack, validates live tracks and preserves actual supported media MIME types.
Late streams, recorder failure, stop failure, cancellation and unmount release tracks and settle pending promises.
notifications: Notification consent continues to use the real Apple authorization API.
APNs registration and AppDelegate success/failure callbacks are implemented behind an explicit configuration flag.
Device tokens are not exposed to H5, logged or persisted; no provider or remote delivery is fabricated.
APNs registration is currently disabled because formal signing, entitlement and provider integration have not been supplied.

unit_tests.selection: scripts/*.test.mjs excluding browser/visual suites and the two external integration drivers auto-match-background.test.mjs and connection-pages.test.mjs
unit_tests.not_claimed: This unit run is not a complete browser visual regression.

real_microphone.notes: Earlier attempts exposed an obsolete icon-control test locator, not a final recorder failure. The final test checks the visible recording state and completes a short recording.

warnings: Xcode emits the standard AppIntents metadata-extraction-skipped warning because this app does not depend on AppIntents.framework.
The simulator logs WebRTC/CoreAudio and WebKit process-assertion advisories; the final real record/send/reload/play test passes. No private system entitlement was added to silence these logs.
verification.process_cleanup: All task-owned build/test commands exited. No dev server or watch process was started. Temporary export/archive directories and microphone test media were cleaned; unrelated simulator processes were left untouched.

external_dependencies_not_verified: Formal Bundle Identifier and Apple Team ID are still missing; the project retains the approved com.cimoa.neapo.dev development identifier without a configured team.
App Store Connect ownership, product availability and Sandbox/TestFlight purchase success/cancellation/pending/relaunch delivery still require the correctly signed app and actual store configuration.
No actual Apple purchase was initiated by this task, and automated recovery tests are not evidence of a real payment.
APNs entitlement, provider API, account/device registration and remote notification delivery are not configured or accepted.
No signed IPA export, App Store upload, full physical-device matrix or complete visual page acceptance is claimed.
Cross-device purchase-account reconciliation without the original protected account-token mapping requires a separately supplied authoritative account service; it is not guessed.

worktree.note: This workspace already contains substantial changes from earlier tasks. This report lists the files touched by this bridge task; it does not claim that all existing working-tree changes originated here or that the working tree is clean.
